class.name: AbilitySystemComponent
class.brief_description: Node that owns a pawn abilities, gameplay tags, effects and attributes.
class.description: The hub of the ability system. Grants and activates [GameplayAbility] resources, applies [GameplayEffect]s, counts owned gameplay tags and holds an [AttributeSet]. The attribute set is duplicated at runtime, so the resource on disk is a template and is never mutated by play. Owned tags are reference counted: the same tag granted by two sources needs both to release it before it is gone. That is why one ability ending does not strip a tag another ability still grants. [b]Networked, the server's component is the truth.[/b] Under [member replication_mode] every client's component is a mirror of it: attributes, owned tags and gameplay cues reach every peer; active effects reach the owner, or everyone; the granted abilities reach the owner, who asks the server to activate them - and runs a [constant GameplayAbility.LOCAL_PREDICTED] one at once, without waiting. On a replicated client effects are not applied, abilities are not granted and base values are not set: all three arrive from the server. A client that joins, or whose pawn spawns, is handed the whole state once ([signal replicated_state_received]), and changes after that. The owner is whoever owns the [Pawn] beside this node - or the [PlayerState] above it - and ability requests from any other peer are dropped. C# scripts cannot inherit GDExtension classes, so consume this compositionally - place the node, author the resources, call the methods and connect to the signals.

method.name: ability_local_input_pressed
method.description: Routes a pressed input action to whichever granted abilities name it in [member GameplayAbility.input_action_name]. Call this from an [InputComponent] binding on the pawn - the ability system never reads input itself.

method.name: ability_local_input_released
method.description: The release half of [method ability_local_input_pressed].

method.name: add_gameplay_cue
method.description: Starts a persistent cue - a status shown for as long as something lasts - on every peer, with [param parameters]. Counted: added twice, it has to be removed twice. A peer that joins while it runs is handed it. Duration and infinite effects add and remove their [member GameplayEffect.gameplay_cue_tags] through this.

method.name: add_gameplay_cue_by_name
method.description: [method add_gameplay_cue], by tag name. [param skip_owner] leaves the owning client out of what the server sends, for a cue it already played itself - see [method GameplayAbility.add_gameplay_cue], which sets it for you.

method.name: add_loose_gameplay_tag
method.description: Adds [param count] to a tag's count with no effect or ability behind it - a "Stunned" set from a script. It counts like any other source, so remove it with [method remove_loose_gameplay_tag] the same number of times. On the server it replicates like every owned tag.

method.name: apply_gameplay_effect_spec_to_self
method.description: Applies an effect as described by [param spec] - its level, source and set-by-caller values. Returns -1 when application was blocked (or refused because this is a replicated client), 0 for an instant effect, and the active effect's id otherwise. An aggregate-stacking effect that is already active returns that effect's id, one stack higher.

method.name: apply_gameplay_effect_spec_to_target
method.description: Applies [param spec] to another component, with this one as its source if the spec has none yet. What an ability hitting something calls.

method.name: apply_gameplay_effect_to_self
method.description: Applies [param effect]. Returns [code]-1[/code] when the tag gates blocked it, [code]0[/code] for an instant effect, and the active id (above zero) for a duration or infinite one - keep that to remove it later.

method.name: apply_gameplay_effect_to_target
method.description: A spec at [param level] with this component as the source, applied to [param target]. Attribute-based modifiers reading the source read this component.

method.name: can_apply_effects
method.description: False on a replicated client, where effects arrive from the server instead of being applied.

method.name: cancel_abilities_with_tags
method.description: Ends every active ability whose [member GameplayAbility.ability_tags] match [param tag_container], as a cancellation.

method.name: cancel_all_abilities
method.description: Ends every active ability as cancelled.

method.name: clear_ability
method.description: Removes a granted ability. Ends it first if it is running.

method.name: clear_all_abilities
method.description: Cancels and removes every granted ability.

method.name: client_ability_activated
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_ability_ended
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_ability_given
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_ability_removed
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_activation_confirmed
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_activation_rejected
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_effect_added
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_effect_removed
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_effect_updated
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_gameplay_cue
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_receive_full_state
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_update_attributes
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: client_update_tags
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the server to a client.

method.name: execute_gameplay_cue
method.description: Fires a one-off cue - a sound, a hit spark - with [param parameters]. On the server it goes to every peer; on a replicated client it plays only here. Every peer that hears a cue emits [signal gameplay_cue] and runs the cue's handler from the [GameplayCueTable]s ([GameplayCueNotify] or a scene), except a dedicated server, which only sends it. Instant effects and period ticks execute their [member GameplayEffect.gameplay_cue_tags] through this with [code]level[/code], [code]stack_count[/code], [code]magnitude[/code] (the first modifier's, stacks included), [code]source_path[/code] (the source's avatar), [code]effect_path[/code], the spec's [code]context[/code], and [code]location[/code]/[code]normal[/code] lifted out of it. Inside an ability use [method GameplayAbility.execute_gameplay_cue] instead: through the component, a predicted ability's cue is heard twice by the client that predicted it.

method.name: execute_gameplay_cue_by_name
method.description: [method execute_gameplay_cue], by tag name; [param skip_owner] as in [method add_gameplay_cue_by_name].

method.name: find_ability_by_handle
method.description: The granted ability with this handle, or null. Handles are the same on the server and on the owning client.

method.name: find_ability_by_name
method.description: The granted ability with this [member GameplayAbility.ability_name], or null.

method.name: get_activatable_abilities
method.description: Every ability currently granted to this component.

method.name: get_active_effect
method.description: The active effect with this id, or null.

method.name: get_active_effect_remaining_time
method.description: Seconds left on the active effect with this id; 0 when it has no duration or is gone. On a client the mirror counts down locally between the server's updates.

method.name: get_active_effect_stack_count
method.description: The stack count of the active effect with this id; 0 when it is gone.

method.name: get_active_effects
method.description: Every non-instant effect currently applied, as [ActiveGameplayEffect] handles.

method.name: get_attribute_base_value
method.description: The authored value, before any modifier.

method.name: get_attribute_set
method.description: The runtime attribute set - the duplicate, not the template on disk.

method.name: get_attribute_value
method.description: The attribute's value after modifiers. This is the one gameplay reads.

method.name: get_blocked_ability_tags
method.description: The tags currently blocking abilities from activating.

method.name: get_effects_time_remaining_with_granted_tags
method.description: The longest time left among active duration effects granting any of these tags - which, given an ability's cooldown tags, is how long its cooldown has to go.

method.name: get_gameplay_tag_count
method.description: How many sources currently grant this exact tag.

method.name: get_owned_gameplay_tags
method.description: The tags this component currently holds, from abilities, effects and [method update_tag_map] together. Query it with [method GameplayTagContainer.has_tag], which matches hierarchically.

method.name: get_owner_peer_id
method.description: The peer that owns this component: the owner of the [Pawn] beside it, or of the [PlayerState] above it; the server otherwise.

method.name: give_ability
method.description: Grants a copy of [param ability_template] and calls its [method GameplayAbility._on_give_ability]. [param source_object] is remembered as the ability's source - the weapon or item it came from - and read back with [method GameplayAbility.get_source_object].

method.name: has_all_matching_gameplay_tags
method.description: Whether the owner has every tag in the container, parents matching children.

method.name: has_any_matching_gameplay_tags
method.description: Whether the owner has any tag in the container, parents matching children.

method.name: has_authority
method.description: True wherever this component is its own truth: offline, on the server, and for a component that does not replicate.

method.name: has_matching_gameplay_tag
method.description: Whether the owner has this tag, or a child of it.

method.name: is_gameplay_cue_active
method.description: Whether a persistent cue is running.

method.name: is_replicated_client
method.description: True on a client whose component mirrors the server's.

method.name: is_replication_state_received
method.description: On a replicated client, whether the server's full state has arrived. Before it, attributes are the template's and nothing is granted.

method.name: make_outgoing_spec
method.description: A [GameplayEffectSpec] for [param effect] at [param level], with this component as its source - to set set-by-caller values or context on before applying it.

method.name: register_gameplay_tag_event
method.description: Calls [param tag_delegate] whenever [param tag]'s presence flips on this component. Not called for a count change that keeps the tag present.

method.name: remove_active_effects_with_tags
method.description: Removes every active effect whose [member GameplayEffect.effect_tags] match, and returns how many. This is what a cleanse is made of.

method.name: remove_active_gameplay_effect
method.description: Removes the effect with [param active_id], releasing its granted tags and modifiers. Returns whether one was found.

method.name: remove_gameplay_cue
method.description: Removes one count of a persistent cue; it ends on every peer when the last is gone.

method.name: remove_gameplay_cue_by_name
method.description: [method remove_gameplay_cue], by tag name; [param skip_owner] as in [method add_gameplay_cue_by_name].

method.name: remove_loose_gameplay_tag
method.description: Removes [param count] from a tag added with [method add_loose_gameplay_tag].

method.name: runs_ability_logic
method.description: Whether an ability's script and tags run on this machine - everywhere except a replicated client for a [constant GameplayAbility.SERVER_ONLY] ability, which is only marked active there.

method.name: send_gameplay_event
method.description: Tells this component's abilities that something happened - an animation reaching its hit frame, a projectile landing - with [param payload]. Running abilities waiting in [method GameplayAbility.wait_gameplay_event] hear it first; then every ability whose [member GameplayAbility.trigger_event_tags] match it is activated, where it may be triggered. Local to this machine: the event itself is not replicated - as in Unreal - but a predicted activation it triggers takes the payload to the server.

method.name: server_ability_input
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the owning client to the server; dropped from anyone else.

method.name: server_ability_target_data
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the owning client to the server, for [method GameplayAbility.sync_target_data].

method.name: server_end_ability
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the owning client to the server; dropped from anyone else.

method.name: server_request_full_state
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. A client asking for the whole state, from its [code]_ready[/code].

method.name: server_try_activate_ability
method.description: Remote call, sent by the component itself; not for game code. From the owning client to the server; dropped from anyone else.

method.name: set_attribute_base_value
method.description: Writes the authored value and recomputes the current one. Use it for a permanent change; a temporary one belongs in a [GameplayEffect].

method.name: try_activate_ability
method.description: Finds the granted ability called [param ability_name] and activates it if [method GameplayAbility.can_activate_ability] passes. Returns whether it started.

method.name: try_activate_ability_by_handle
method.description: [method try_activate_ability], by handle.

method.name: update_blocked_ability_tags
method.description: Adds [param count_delta] to a blocking tag's reference count directly, without an ability doing the blocking.

method.name: update_tag_map
method.description: Adds [param count_delta] to an owned tag's reference count directly - for a tag no ability or effect owns. Remember that a grant of [code]+1[/code] needs a matching [code]-1[/code].

members.member: The [AttributeSet] template. It is [b]duplicated at runtime[/b], so the resource on disk is never mutated by play and the same set can be shared by every pawn of a kind.

How much of this component a client is sent. [constant REPLICATION_FULL] by default. Ignored offline. Read on every peer, so it must be the same on the server and the clients - set it in the scene, not at runtime.
Abilities granted when the component is ready.
Effects applied when the component is ready - a good place for the permanent modifiers a character starts with.

signal.name: ability_activation_failed
signal.description: Emitted when an activation is refused, with why - see [method GameplayAbility.get_last_failure_reason]. On a predicting client, [code]&"rejected"[/code] means the server refused an activation the client had already started; the ability has been cancelled.

signal.name: ability_ended
signal.description: An ability ended; [param was_canceled] says whether it was interrupted.

signal.name: ability_given
signal.description: Emitted when an ability is granted - on the server, and on the owning client when the grant arrives.

signal.name: attribute_changed
signal.description: A current attribute value changed, after modifiers. This is what UI should listen to.

signal.name: gameplay_cue
signal.description: Emitted for a gameplay cue, on every peer that hears it: [param event_type] is a [enum CueEvent]. The presentation layer listens here - never game logic.

signal.name: gameplay_effect_applied
signal.description: An effect was applied, with the handle [method apply_gameplay_effect_to_self] returned.

signal.name: gameplay_effect_removed
signal.description: An effect ended, expired or was removed.

signal.name: gameplay_effect_stack_changed
signal.description: Emitted when an aggregate-stacking effect gains or loses a stack.

signal.name: owned_tag_changed
signal.description: An owned tag's reference count changed. [param new_count] of zero means the component no longer has the tag.

signal.name: replicated_state_received
signal.description: Emitted on a replicated client when the server's full state has been applied - the moment a HUD can read real values.

constants.constant: Nothing is sent, and every peer runs its own component - what every component did before replication.
Attributes, owned tags and gameplay cues to every peer, the ability list to the owner, active effects to nobody.
As minimal, and active effects to the owner - a player's HUD shows their own buffs. Unreal's recommendation for player-controlled characters.
As minimal, and active effects to every peer - an enemy's buffs can be shown above its head.
Something started and lasts until [constant CUE_REMOVED].
Something that was added has ended.
